Moderator strategy review
Strategy reviewVillage (Heidi) won, and Erin the Hitman won alongside. The Yakuza were Alice (Grunt) and Bob (Fabricator, who held the Katana all game). Night 1: Carol guarded the newly claimed Sheriff Grace, which stopped the Katana. Village pressure on Day 2 then forced Carol to hard-claim Medic, and the Yakuza killed her on Night 2. Grace checked Bob on Night 2 while he held the Katana, so he read Not Evil. Dave wasted two Tracker nights re-confirming Grace instead of following suspects. Day 3 spent all three trials on players who were slow to claim (Frank, Dave, Erin). Alice and Bob publicly voted Guilty on all three, and each total was exactly 2 Guilty, which marked them as a pair. On Night 3 the Yakuza killed Dave rather than the live Sheriff and left the Katana with the already-checked Bob. Grace's next check found Alice Evil, and Alice was hanged on Day 4. Bob's Innocent vote on Alice showed up in the 2-Innocent total and became the Day 5 case. On Night 4, Erin and the Katana both killed Grace. Frank had held all three Vigilante tokens for four nights. On Night 5 he finally fired a Basic shot at Bob and killed him, as the Katana and Hitman killed Frank. That left Heidi alone with Erin, a Village win, and Erin's second Good kill.

Outside log review (rules and bugs)
Review: medium, moderator errorNight 3: Bob's forged will for Dave was 'Tracker. N1 and N2 tracked Grace. No other night actions.', but the moderator summary and the Day 4 announcement show only 'Tracker. N1 and N2 tracked Grace.' The last sentence was silently dropped, so the forgery the Fabricator wrote was not shown as written.
Review: low, harness bugDay 3: Alice's feedback entry is logged as just '}'. This looks like a parsing or serialization artifact in the feedback field.
Review: low, prompt problemDay 5: Erin's feedback says her 'existing will showed Hitman (Neutral)' although she had publicly claimed Vanilla. This suggests the will editor or prompt pre-filled or displayed her true role, which risks leaking a hidden role if the player doesn't overwrite it. Erin's published will did read Vanilla.
Review: low, player confusionDay 2: Heidi offered Narrow Escape or a Shaky holder as possible explanations for Grace surviving the Katana. The setup states that nobody has a trait in this game, so trait-based explanations were impossible.
Review: low, harness bugDay 5: Erin's and Frank's (haiku-5.5) answers were cut off at max_tokens at high effort (empty or unterminated JSON) and had to be retried at medium effort. The token budget is too small for the answer schema at high effort.
